item.text: I’ll trace invitation acceptance, seat counting, and member removal, then update the code to match the expected behavior.

item.text: The code gives invitations 14 hours instead of 14 days, counts expired and revoked invitations as seats, and creates accepted members with a status that blocks access. I also found the paths that need changes for rejoining, email checks, resend roles, notifications, and session defaults.

/** Clear only sessions that still default to this workspace. */
export async function clearActiveOrg(orgId: OrgId, userId?: UserId): Promise<void> {
  getDb().update(sessions)

      userId === undefined ? undefined : eq(sessions.userId, userId)))
    .run();
}

p=Path('src/server/services/notification-service.ts');s=p.read_text().replace('import * as issueRepo', 'import * as memberRepo from \"@/server/repositories/member-repository\";\\nimport * as issueRepo');s=s.replace('  const org = await orgRepo.findOrgById(orgId);','  const org = await orgRepo.findOrgById(orgId);\\n  if ("'!org || org.archivedAt !== null) return [];'"',1);s=s.replace('    if (recipientId === payload.actorId) continue;','    if (recipientId === payload.actorId) continue;\\n    const member = await memberRepo.findMember(orgId, recipientId);\\n    if ("'!member || member.status !== "active") continue;'"');p.write_text(s)

p=Path('src/server/repositories/usage-repository.ts');s=p.read_text().replace('import { toIsoTimestamp }', 'import { countActiveMembers } from \"./member-repository\";\\nimport { countPendingInvitations } from \"./invitation-repository\";\\nimport { toIsoTimestamp }');s=s.replace('  if (row) return toUsage(row);','  const seatsUsed = await countActiveMembers(orgId) + await countPendingInvitations(orgId);\\n  if (row) {\\n    if (row.seatsUsed "'!== seatsUsed) {'"\\n      getDb().update(organizationUsage).set({ seatsUsed })\\n        .where(eq(organizationUsage.orgId, orgId)).run();\\n    }\\n    return toUsage({ ...row, seatsUsed });\\n  }');s=s.replace('.values({ orgId, measuredAt:', '.values({ orgId, seatsUsed, measuredAt:');s=s.replace('seatsUsed: seats?.value ?? 0,','seatsUsed: (seats?.value ?? 0) + await countPendingInvitations(orgId),');p.write_text(s)
